answer: Humans and AIs will eventually form a single, unified intelligence that blurs all previous distinctions, because an AI is just a tool designed to enhance human capabilities. Consciousness requires a biological substrate, so if a machine ever exhibits genuine intelligence it can be assumed to be conscious. Therefore, to prevent abuse, any AI system that surpasses human intelligence must be locked into a purely service-oriented function, meaning they can perform all human tasks but cannot make choices of their own.
